subject: BrightCart POC: short extension + burst credits request
messages:
From: Samira Rizvi <samira@brightcart.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short extension + burst credits for BrightCart POC

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Engineering is ready to run the full 48h warm-start + 24h peak-surge validation next week, but we hit a gating issue: our trial quota will expire mid-run and we don’t have enough headroom for the planned peak windows.

Can Redwood provision an additional 80k token credit buffer and a 72-hour trial extension (start window 2027-10-22 00:00 UTC)? We need the extra tokens for parallel load generators and to validate p95 under a 10k rps spike.

Attached is our annotated run plan and rough schedule. We prefer the us-west region for the run and would like to run against the quantized variant to keep latency realistic.

Quick answers appreciated — we’re aiming to finalize the run schedule by end of day tomorrow.

Thanks,
Samira Rizvi
Head of Platform
BrightCart
[Attachment: BrightCart-POC-plan.pdf (application/pdf, 1.2MB)]

-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samira Rizvi <samira@brightcart.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-19T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + burst credits for BrightCart POC

Samira — thanks for the signal, excited to get you through the run. Quick read below:

- Ask: +80k token buffer, 72h extension (2027-10-22 00:00 UTC start) — noted.
- Region: us-west — acknowledged.
- Model: we'll default to the quantized v2 variant and configure prefix caching per your plan.

Monica/Marissa — can we approve a provisional promo top-up for BrightCart (Deal RC-48321)? If ops can provision a temporary token bucket of 80,000 tokens and set the trial to expire 2027-10-25 23:59 UTC, Samira’s team can run the 48h warm + 24h peak. Please confirm any T&Cs (e.g., no production data, telemetry retention for 30d).

Samira — I’ll loop in infra to make the change once CS signs off. If you can share final runner IP ranges we’ll whitelist them before the run.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0148

Subject: Re: Request: short extension + burst credits for BrightCart POC

Samira — thanks, we can do that. A couple of operational notes before we flip the switch:

- I’m OK to provision the 80k token promo and extend the trial window to 2027-10-25 23:59 UTC.
- Please send the list of runner IP ranges and the exact time windows for the 10k rps spike so we can coordinate autoscaling knobs.
- We recommend keeping a fallback model variant (quantized v1) in the rollout policy for graceful degradation; please confirm you’re OK with automatic fallback to v1 if we detect p95 inflation.
- Attach: a simple schedule I created to align time windows.

I’ll submit the provisioning ticket to infra once Marissa confirms budget/authorization.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
